research_question: Can verified GSE157504 raw-UMI detection and author-reported rhythm calls be shown alongside the current literature-scored candidate list without changing numeric candidate scores or electrophysiology directness gates?
hypothesis: A hash-bound, target-scoped sidecar can expose transcript detection, author HC rhythm calls, and stale-rationale review flags while preserving the original literature score and readout-specific ephys gate.
alternative_hypotheses: Zero raw UMI may reflect single-cell dropout rather than biological absence.
A missing exact feature or a candidate not included in the upstream candidate audit is not evaluable, not evidence of absent expression.
An author HC-list omission is not proof of arrhythmicity.
Transcript detection/rhythm does not establish channel protein, native current, membrane-potential rhythm, or causal behavior.
A mixed LN_ITP call or DN subcluster call may not generalize to a pure clock-neuron subtype or all DN neurons.
preparation: Literature-scored candidate evidence table and checked source log joined to verified GSE157504 raw-UMI detection and author-reported rhythm output; no new wet-lab assay or rhythm refit.
cell_type: s-LNv, l-LNv, LNd, and DN; LN_ITP is retained only as an ambiguous cluster and DN author calls retain cluster/subcluster labels.
experimental_unit: Descriptive candidate-by-target-group rows; cells are nested observations and not independent flies.
primary_readout: One transcript-context sidecar row per candidate and target group, with LD/ZT and DD/CT detection counts, author HC rhythm calls, and unchanged target-specific candidate score/ephys gate.
secondary_readouts: Candidate-set difference between the literature shortlist and GSE candidate audit.
Static literature rationale flags for human review where transcript context may warrant wording reconciliation.
Manifest validation and isolated replay output-hash verification.
time_system: LD is ZT; DD is CT; reported source phase is preserved.
required_metadata: Candidate symbol and literature class, kept distinct from GSE priority class.
Exact raw-feature status; LD/DD time system; target group; annotated/detected cells; raw counts and fraction.
Author cluster, HC call, F24 score, reported phase, and JTK_BH q-value where listed.
Candidate/source-log validation, parent manifest ID/status, parent replay status, and SHA-256 hashes.
Existing target-specific score, coverage, directness score/gate, shortlist gate, and readout for parity.
analysis_plan: Validate the literature candidate table and source log; verify the GSE-derived input hashes against the parent raw/rhythm manifest, manifest validation, and isolated replay; recompute each candidate's target score only as a parity check against the four existing score CSVs; build a sidecar with one row per literature candidate x target group; validate the new provenance manifest and replay the builder in an isolated mirror.
decision_gate: Accept only if there are 60 unique candidate-by-target rows; all 15 candidate rows and four target score tables align; candidate scores, coverage, readout, and directness/shortlist gates match existing artifacts; uncertainty and subtype-scope semantics are preserved; and all declared output hashes match in isolated replay.
acceptance_tests: Synthetic zero-UMI values are marked dropout-sensitive rather than absent; missing target HC calls are not called arrhythmic.
Synthetic LN_ITP HC calls stay in the ambiguous field and are not assigned to s-LNv or LNd; DN1p retains exact cluster scope.
Duplicate group-condition records and LD/ZT or DD/CT mismatches fail closed.
A feature not represented in the matrix and a candidate absent from the upstream candidate audit both remain explicitly not evaluable.
Real data produce 15 literature candidates x four targets; candidate-set difference reports literature-only na and GSE-only eag instead of silently reconciling them.
Shab LD s-LNv detection is 160/181 and DD is 97/142; its s-LNv LD/DD author HC calls remain listed; score and ephys gate remain unchanged.
All four target score CSVs match recomputed candidate score, coverage, directness score/gate, shortlist gate and scoring readout.
The context manifest hashes the builder and its transitive helper scripts; manifest validation and isolated replay verify all outputs.

verification.target_score_parity: verified for score, coverage, directness score/gate, shortlist gate and readout across four targets
verification.new_isolated_replay_status: verified_public_dataset_replay; 1 run; 2 output hashes verified; 0 issues

result_summary: Built a 60-row context sidecar for 15 literature candidates across s-LNv, l-LNv, LNd and DN. Shab's s-LNv raw UMI detection and author HC rhythm calls are shown alongside its original literature score and needs_direct_evidence gate; neither score nor gate is altered. The literature list contains na, which is absent from the upstream GSE candidate audit, while GSE-only eag is reported as a set difference. Static rationales for Shab and cac are flagged for human review only.
limitations: Single-cell raw UMI fractions are descriptive and cells are not independent biological replicates.
Zero counts are dropout-sensitive; exact feature absence and omission from the upstream candidate audit are not biological absence.
Author rhythm rows are transcribed, not refit; no author HC-list row is not proof of arrhythmicity.
LN_ITP is mixed/ambiguous; DN subgroup calls do not generalize to all DN.
No protein abundance, native channel current, membrane-potential rhythm, causal channel function, or behavioral result is measured by this overlay.
A review flag does not automatically revise the literature candidate rationale or ranking; human source review is required.
